headline: Patrick Stewart Remembered by Hollywood
post:
Following the news of Patrick Stewart, tributes have been pouring in from across the entertainment world. Director Bryan Singer shared memories of his time working with the X-Men star, recalling a dinner where Stewart surprised him with William Shatner.

William Shatner also shared a heartfelt tribute to his friend and colleague, remembering the grace and humanity he brought to his legendary roles on stage and screen. Further updates will follow.

headline: X-Men's Krakoa debuts with ultimate mutant powers
post:
Hey everyone! Marvel has just dropped an incredible new character into the mix. According to Screen Rant, the living island Krakoa has arrived with the combined abilities of iconic heroes like Cyclops, Colossus, Wolverine, Jean Grey, and Magneto. 🏝️

This massive reveal happens in the pages of Godzilla Conquers the Multiverse #4. Emma Frost calls in backup from an alternate reality known as "Universe M," where the mutant nation of Krakoa survived and spent decades feeding on its residents in a controlled symbiosis.

Beyond just the wild action of fighting the King of Monsters, this story establishes a permanent ongoing alternate reality where the Krakoan Era continues unabated. It opens up huge possibilities for future comic storylines now that our heroes know this timeline exists.

Which mutant power would you want to see combined first? 

#XMen #MarvelComics #Krakoa
original_title: X-Men's New Hero Officially Combines Powers of Cyclops and Colossus

post:

headline: Green Lantern #40: Alexandra DeWitt returns
post:
Hey fellow DC fans! Big changes are coming to the cosmic side of the universe. According to Screen Rant, DC is bringing back a classic villain with a major twist in Green Lantern #40. 💚

In the latest issue written by Jeremy Adams, a surprising new character takes on the mantle of Black Hand. Alexandra DeWitt rises from the muck after Nekron tells her that her pain has been "found worthy." Fans remember DeWitt as the former girlfriend of Kyle Rayner who was tragically killed early in his career.

Nekron appears to be manipulating DeWitt and weaponizing her discontent. This shocking return is bound to shake Kyle's faith and spell trouble for the entire Green Lantern Corps.

Are you reading the latest Green Lantern issues? 📖

#GreenLantern #DCComics #KyleRayner
original_title: DC Confirms It's Rebooting Classic Villain for Next Green Lantern Appearance

headline: Eva Mendes joins Ryan Gosling in Starfighter
post:
Eva Mendes is reportedly joining her husband Ryan Gosling in the upcoming movie Star Wars: Starfighter, directed by Shawn Levy. Reports indicate she will play the owner of an intergalactic cantina named Belle, marking her first live-action film appearance in over a decade. However, Lucasfilm has not yet confirmed her casting or character details.

Set five years after The Rise of Skywalker, the film also stars Flynn Gray, Matt Smith, Mia Goth, Aaron Pierre, and Amy Adams, and is scheduled to hit theaters on May 28th, 2027. 

Are you excited to see Eva Mendes return to the big screen in a Star Wars cantina? 🌌

#StarWars #Starfighter #RyanGosling
original_title: Ryan Gosling’s New Star Wars Movie Will Reunite Him With Wife Eva Mendes, & We Know Who She’s Playing
